question:
**Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.**

Without vision, the process of conceptualisation can become ______ task for any individual.
solution:
The correct answer is: "**an onerous**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**
__
 
• "**Onerous**" means burdensome or difficult to accomplish. (बोझिल या पूरा करना कठिन)
 
 
• **Example**: *The task was so onerous that it took all day to complete.*
 
 
 
• The sentence suggests that having a vision is important for the process of conceptualisation.
 
• Without vision, the process can become burdensome or difficult for an individual.
 
• Therefore, "**an onerous**" is the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

Hence, **option 2** is the correct answer.

**Complete sentence**: *Without vision, the process of conceptualisation can become an onerous__ task for any individual.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• "**A gregarious**" means sociable or fond of company. (मिलनसार या संगति का शौकीन)
 
• "**A contrarious**" means stubborn or difficult to manage. (जिद्दी या प्रबंधन करना कठिन)
 
• "**A lively**" means energetic or full of life. (ऊर्जावान या जीवन से भरपूर)
